verdict.rationale: Docs confirm crash reporting works across multiple platforms (JavaScript with source maps for frontend, ProGuard mapping for Android, dSYMs for iOS, and community confirms .NET/WinRT support for backend/desktop) and captures rich stack trace/environment data automatically. However, there is no single consolidated SDK list or explicit 'auto-capture uncaught exceptions' language per platform, and no independent hands-on verification of backend service instrumentation. Missing for 10: an explicit unified SDK catalog covering web, backend, and mobile with confirmation of automatic uncaught-exception capture, plus independent corroboration beyond one old HN thread.
